Name: Fall 28 Snow Day
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Makes snow fall on Fall 28. Now we know why the world is covered in snow on Winter 1st.

[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.3+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 2.6 -Beta or later.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size]
It automatically snows on Fall 28.
